## Definition of Done
- [ ] (a) Code compiles without warnings and passes Flutter/Dart lint rules
- [ ] (b) Feature passes all Work Package Acceptance Criteria on emulator
- [ ] (c) Pull Request reviewed and approved by at least one teammate
- [ ] (d) Unit and validation tests pass
- [ ] (e) Mandatory attributions ("© Gym visual" and AI advisory notice) preserved on relevant screens
- [ ] (f) Corresponding GitHub Project Board card moved to 'Done' with PR link
